TITLE: The Ladder That Ends in a Question
TEXT:
There is a ladder behind the market
that ends at a blank ceiling.
People climb it anyway.

At the top you can see:
- the dust on the pipes
- the geometry of wires
- the way light hesitates

You expect a hatch.
You expect a door.
You expect reward.

Instead you get a question:
What did you think would be waiting for you
above the room you are afraid to live in?
